ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17, of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance be amended by changing all the RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached
House) District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 15-M in the area
bounded by

North Elston Avenue; a line 107 feet southeast of the intersection

of North Major Avenue and North Elston Avenue, as measured

along the southerly right-of-way line of North Elston Avenue and

perpendicular thereto; the alley next south of and parallel to

North Elston Avenue; a line 82 feet south-east of the intersection of

North Milwaukee Avenue and North Mango Avenue as measured along north
Elston Avenue and perpendicular thereto

to those of a RT3.5 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District
SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage

and due publication.

Common Address of Property: 5754 North Elston Avenue
